plan: To preserve capital, we will sell all leveraged ETFs (SOXL, SPAL, MUU, METU) to zero.
We will trim SPY to 20% to reduce broad index concentration and meet mandate limits.
QQQI will be increased to 25% to favor income and stability.
CRWD will be trimmed to 10% to manage single name concentration.
This plan prioritizes capital preservation and low drawdown.
conservative.read: This conservative approach targets around 1.5% per month, focusing on capital preservation. It significantly reduces leverage and concentration, aiming for steady, low-drawdown performance. Expect lower volatility but also limited upside potential.

plan: For balanced growth, we will trim SOXL to 3%, SPAL to 1%, MUU to 3%, and METU to 2% to reduce overall leverage.
SPY will be trimmed to 25% to comply with concentration limits.
CRWD will be trimmed to 10% to manage single name concentration.
We will buy GEV at 4% as a strong new scanner setup.
This plan balances growth with risk management, maintaining a small cash buffer.
balanced.read: This balanced approach targets around 2.5% per month, prioritizing risk-first growth. It blends broad index exposure with quality tech and a small amount of leverage. Expect moderate volatility and growth potential, with a focus on managing drawdowns.

plan: For aggressive growth, SPY will be trimmed to 25% to meet concentration limits.
We will add to SOXL (7%), MUU (6%), METU (6%), and SPAL (6%) to lean into leveraged ETFs.
New positions will be opened in GEV (6%) and TSM (5%) from the strongest scanner setups.
This strategy aims to press what is working and utilize leverage for higher potential returns.
Strict stop discipline is crucial for managing increased risk.
aggressive.read: This aggressive approach targets around 4% per month, aiming for stretched growth. It significantly increases exposure to leveraged ETFs and concentrates in high-scoring setups. Be aware this raises both upside and drawdown potential, and leveraged ETFs experience daily decay and rebalancing. Strict stop discipline is essential to manage the higher risk.

plan: To prioritize income, we will sell all leveraged ETFs (SOXL, SPAL, MUU, METU) to zero.
High-beta single names like CRWD and SNOW will also be sold to zero.
SPY will be trimmed to 20% to reduce broad index concentration.
QQQI will be significantly increased to 30% to maximize income exposure.
This plan focuses on steady monthly distributions and low drawdown.
income.read: This income approach targets around 1% per month, aiming to park cash for yield. It rotates into income-focused ETFs and broad index exposure, cutting high-beta and leveraged positions. While prioritizing low drawdown and reliable income, distributions are variable, and NAV can still fall in a selloff.
